leitstand-machine.title: Phone Leitstand is about 7.5 screens long; no compact machine list or way to jump between sections
leitstand-machine.evidence: At 400px the view is 6280px tall. The 13 machine tiles are each about 300px (tool box, staff row, buffer bar) and are only reachable after 6 KPI tiles and 'Jetzt wichtig' (/tmp/rv-mobile/m-phone-leitstand-*.png). Material (8180px), Werkzeuge (8160px) and Personal (5820px) have the same problem. A best-in-class mobile MES shows a one-line-per-machine status list.
leitstand-machine.fix: At ≤560px, render tiles in a compact mode: one 56px row per machine (state pill, name, order/part, ETA, small progress bar), tap to expand or open the drawer. Show the KPI tiles as a horizontal swipe strip (like Aufträge) so 'Jetzt wichtig' starts above the fold. Optionally add sticky jump chips (KPIs · Wichtig · Maschinen · Briefing).

leitstand-machine.title: Pulse animations animate box-shadow and repaint every frame
leitstand-machine.evidence: 40_leitstand.js:117 runs 'lsPulse … infinite' on box-shadow for every running tile (12 at once). Leitstand frame rate with the sim paused (software raster): 5 fps; with animations disabled 13 fps; with filters/shadows also off 29.5 fps; a blank page runs at 60 fps (rvcons/fps.js). The same pattern exists in orPulse (41_orders) and mtFlow/mtSd (45_material, 13 + 12 running animations).
leitstand-machine.fix: Animate transform: scale and opacity of a ::after ring (compositor-only) instead of box-shadow. Alternatively pulse only attention states (fault/wait) and not the 12 normal 'Produktion' pills.

leitstand-machine.title: TV mode does not fit 1080p: third tile row is cut off, page scrolls, and the controls are still visible
leitstand-machine.evidence: /tmp/rv-art-desktop/v2-tv-1920.png and /tmp/rv-art-desktop/tv-1920.png. With WF.app.setTv(true) at 1920×1080 the view has scrollHeight 1871 against clientHeight 1022. The bottom row (Waschanlage, Messraum, Montage) is cut at the screen edge, the KI-Schichtbriefing is below the fold, and 2 of the 5 grid cells in row 3 are empty. The top bar with speed buttons, bell, Copilot and settings is still shown (display:flex), although the code comment at line 226 promises 'keine Bedienelemente … alle 13 Arbeitsplätze ohne Scrollen'. Tile text stays at desktop size (about 13 px), so it cannot be read from a few metres.
leitstand-machine.fix: (1) In 20_app.js, for .app.tv: hide .top, or replace it with a 44 px strip showing brand, clock and shift only. Also set grid-template-rows: 0 minmax(0,1fr). (2) In .ls-root.ls-tv: hide .ls-brief and 'Gerade passiert'. Make .ls-main a single column with the 'Jetzt wichtig' rail at 340px. Use .ls-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-rows:1fr;height:calc(100vh - <header> - <kpi> - <chips>)}. (3) Drop the redundant cause line in TV tiles (see the tile-redundancy finding); this saves about 36 px per tile, so 3 rows fit: 3×247+20 = 761 px against about 820 px available. (4) Scale type for TV: tile name 24px, pill 15px, part counter 18px, tool row 14px. (5) Fill the 2 empty cells with a shift-summary tile (output against plan, next 3 events) instead of leaving holes.

leitstand-machine.title: Machine tiles repeat themselves and leave holes; 13 tiles leave an orphan
leitstand-machine.evidence: /tmp/rv-art-desktop/1440-leitstand-0.png, -2.png, /tmp/rv-art-desktop/1920-leitstand-0.png. The cause line 'Teil 39/80 FA-24122 AG 10 in Bearbeitung' restates the order block directly below ('FA-24122 … Teil 39 von 80 · fertig ca. 10:06'). Its reserved 2-line height leaves a gap of about 30 px in most tiles. Part counters use two formats ('39/80' and '39 von 80'). Buffer strip labels 'LAGER AUS', 'EIN ▮▮▮ AUS' are 9.5 px faint. 13 tiles in 3 columns (1440) or 4 columns (1920) leave a lone 'Montage' tile beside a 2–3 tile hole.
leitstand-machine.fix: Render the cause line only when it adds information: state ≠ running, or the text does not start with 'Teil '. Examples worth keeping: 'wird eingelegt (M. Gruber)', 'Abrichten …', 'Frei – nächste Teile …'. Remove its min-height. Use 'Teil 39 von 80' everywhere. Buffer strip: 10.5px --muted, 'Eingang 3/3 · Ausgang 1/3' with title tooltips. Grid: group tiles by area with small eyebrow headers (Dreherei 4 · Fräserei 2 · Sonderbearbeitung/Verzahnung 2 · Schleiferei 2 · Reinigung/QS/Montage 3), so short rows read as intentional groups. Or render Waschanlage, Messraum and Montage as a compact secondary row of 3 smaller tiles.

leitstand-machine.title: Hero OEE and KI-Schichtbriefing headline disagree in the same viewport
leitstand-machine.evidence: Sim paused at Mo 08:40: KPI 'OEE HEUTE 71,8 %' and briefing 'OEE 71,7 % unter Ziel 75 %' (1440-leitstand-0.png and 1440-leitstand-1.png). The briefing is cached for up to 15 sim-minutes (refreshBrief). Also 'V 87 % × L 84 % × Q 98,7 %' in the Leitstand against 'Q 99 %' in Analyse (1440-analyse-0.png).
leitstand-machine.fix: Re-render numeric tokens in the briefing headline from WF.sim.kpis() on every update, keeping only the prose cached. Or state the snapshot time next to the number ('OEE 71,7 % (08:25)'). Use the same formatter and precision (fmtPct(x,1)) for V, L and Q in every view.

leitstand-machine.title: Page title sits 18 px lower in Leitstand than in every other view
leitstand-machine.evidence: DOM probe: .view-t top = 94px in Leitstand and 76px in all other views (1440). The title jumps when clicking through the nav; the shift info block on the right pushes it down.
leitstand-machine.fix: Set .view-h{align-items:flex-start} for the Leitstand header, or vertically centre the shift block on the title row, so every view's title starts at the same y.

leitstand-machine.title: Am Beamer (1280×720) ist keine einzige Maschinenkachel sichtbar
leitstand-machine.evidence: /tmp/rv-prospect/A0-1280-leitstand.png: Kopf mit Schicht/Schichtleitung/Personal und 6 KPI-Kacheln in zwei Reihen à 3 reichen bis y≈530. Darunter nur Statuschips und die oberen ~150 px von zwei Maschinenkacheln. 'Die ganze Halle auf einen Blick' (Tour Schritt 2) stimmt bei typischer Präsentationsauflösung nicht.
leitstand-machine.fix: Bei ≤ 1440 px Breite oder ≤ 800 px Höhe die KPIs als eine Reihe mit 6 kompakten Kacheln (~84 px hoch, Sparkline klein oder ausgeblendet) zeigen und die Schicht/Personal-Chips in die Titelzeile ziehen. Ziel: bei 1280×720 mindestens eine volle Reihe mit 3 Maschinenkacheln über dem Falz. Alternativ den TV-Modus bei kleiner Höhe vorschlagen.

leitstand-machine.title: 'Handlungsbedarf' sortiert die untätige Waschanlage ganz nach oben
leitstand-machine.evidence: 96-leitstand-handlungsbedarf.png: Platz 1 ist M11 Waschanlage 'Bereit · Kein Auftrag aktiv – nächste Teile 12:00' (nichts zu tun). Dahinter M04 mit Werkzeugwechsel in 3 min und M01 mit dem verspäteten FA-24122.
leitstand-machine.fix: Dringlichkeitswert: Störung > Wartet (Material/Bediener/Werkzeug) > anstehender Werkzeugwechsel/Erstteil < 15 min > Maschine eines späten oder knappen Auftrags > frei mit Arbeit in der Warteschlange; frei ohne fällige Arbeit ganz unten.

leitstand-machine.title: Live-signal sparklines are stubs on first open
leitstand-machine.evidence: /tmp/rv-art-desktop/d-machine-M05-1.png: a 15 px squiggle in the right corner of 'Spindeldrehzahl', 'Spindellast' and 'Leistung'. /tmp/rv-art-desktop/d-m05-spark-after12s.png: still only the right ~40 % drawn after 12 s. SAMPLES (lines 177–195) only records since page load, while timeSpark (line 204) fixes the x-domain to at least 300 s back. A prospect clicking a machine right after the splash sees empty charts.
leitstand-machine.fix: At boot, pre-fill SAMPLES for each connected machine with the last SPARK_WIN, derived from WF.sim.state history or synthesised from the current signal with the machine-state band (cycle-shaped noise for rpm and load). Alternatively, while the buffer is younger than SPARK_WIN, set t0 = pts[0].t so the trace spans the full width. Add an end-point dot and a tiny 'letzte 5 min' caption.

leitstand-machine.title: Die 'eine Regel' für Werkzeuge wird an derselben Stelle widersprüchlich erklärt
leitstand-machine.evidence: M05-Drawer 10:30: 'Wechselgrenze ≤ 0 Teile Reststandzeit (ab ca. 80 % Verschleiß)' und direkt darunter 'Regel: … gewechselt wird … sobald höchstens 2 Teile (bzw. 10 % der Standzeit) übrig sind' (50-m05-drawer.png). Werkzeuge-Liste M03 'Planung … bei ≤ 3 Teilen Rest', M02 '≤ 2 Teilen Rest'. Karte 'So plant werkfluss': 'Wechselgrenze 0 Teile' neben 'Angekündigt bei ≤ 2 Teilen Rest' (02-werkzeuge.png). Das README verspricht 'die eine, nachvollziehbare Regel' – ein Einrichter findet hier vier Zahlen.
leitstand-machine.fix: Regeltext in 42_machine.js und 46_tools.js aus zwei sauber benannten Größen bauen, überall gleich: 'Ankündigung: N Teile vorher (Vorlauf zum Holen)' = planHorizonParts und 'Wechsel: an der letzten Teilegrenze, an der die Standzeit noch für ein ganzes Teil reicht (Wechselgrenze = changeAtParts)'. Den festen Satz 'höchstens 2 Teile (bzw. 10 %)' streichen bzw. pro Werkzeug mit dessen Werten füllen.

orders-ki.title: On phone, 'In der Halle verfolgen' keeps the full-screen drawer open; the 3D route is never seen (same for tour step 5)
orders-ki.evidence: In the hall on 400×860, open order FA-24118 and tap 'In der Halle verfolgen'. The app navigates to the hall and calls focusOrder, but `.drawer.open` stays true and the 100%-wide drawer still covers everything (/tmp/rv-mobile/mh2-phone.png). Tour step 5 'Einen Auftrag durch die Fabrik verfolgen' on phone also shows the drawer, not the route (/tmp/rv-mobile/mt-phone-b.png, middle). This is README demo step 2. 42_machine.js line 621 ('In der Halle zeigen') has the same problem. The hall already has a mobile selection bar ('AUFTRAG FA-24118 · Route zeigen', /tmp/rv-mobile/hall-phone-order.png) that would replace the drawer.
orders-ki.fix: In the 'hall' handler (lines 2018-2021) and in 42_machine.js:621, close the drawer when `matchMedia('(max-width:640px)').matches`, before navigate/focus. Because closeDrawer() emits select {kind:null} and would clear the hall selection, add to 20_app.js a `WF.app.closeDrawer({keepSelection:true})` (or `hideDrawer()`) that only removes `.open`. In 70_tour.js step 'order', call that variant on narrow screens instead of leaving the drawer open.

orders-ki.title: 'Freigegeben' tag overlaps the progress figure on order cards at tablet width
orders-ki.evidence: On 768×1024, FA-24123's 'Freigegeben' tag runs into '0 %' of the progress column (/tmp/rv-mobile/zoom-tab-or-freig.png, also visible in m-tab-auftraege-1.png). Cause: `.or-l1{display:flex}` without wrapping, and `.or-tag{flex:none}`, in a first column that is only about 125px wide at this card width. Customer names in the same column are also truncated ('Hydrava Pumpen Gm…', 'Kärntner Antriebste…').
orders-ki.fix: Set `.or-l1{flex-wrap:wrap; row-gap:4px}` and `overflow:hidden` on .or-top. Or, at `@container orcard (max-width:900px)`, move the status tag into the .or-cust line, or show it as a 6px dot plus a tooltip. Consider a minimum first-column width of 190px at this container size so customer names fit.

orders-ki.title: Fortschritt-% wirkt aufgebläht, 'ENGPASS'-Badge auf jedem Auftrag
orders-ki.evidence: 02-auftraege.png: FA-24126 '97 %', obwohl 12/24 Stk noch auf den Messraum warten. 41-auftraege-scroll.png: FA-24127 '98 %' bei 24/36 versandt. Jeder Auftrag trägt ein 'ENGPASS'-Badge, auch 'Im Plan · Puffer 21 h 01 min' (FA-24128).
orders-ki.fix: Als primären Fortschritt Stückzahl zeigen ('12/24 versandt'), den gewichteten Wert als 'Arbeitsinhalt 97 %' beschriften. Das Engpass-Badge nur bei Risiko ≠ ok zeigen, sonst dezent im Tooltip.

orders-ki.title: 'Vergrößern' on phone does not enlarge the drawing
orders-ki.evidence: On 400×860, the lightbox modal is 368px wide and shows the drawing at the same size as the inline preview; drawing text renders at about 3px with no pan or pinch (/tmp/rv-mobile/kizoom-phone.png). The drawing is the starting point of demo step 6.
orders-ki.fix: On ≤640px, open the lightbox fullscreen (`.modal{width:100vw;height:100dvh;border-radius:0}`). Render the SVG at a fixed 1100px width inside `overflow:auto; touch-action:pan-x pan-y pinch-zoom`, scroll it to the title block, and add a 'Querformat empfohlen' hint. Feature balloons (1–8) should stay tappable and scroll to the feature list.

orders-ki.title: Live-Belegung 'frei ab' shows idle machines as busy until tomorrow
orders-ki.evidence:
emptyHtml() (around lines 2410–2413) uses free = max(end) over all forecast entries.
- M10 Okamoto ACC is 'Bereit' with no order at 10:37, 13:58, 18:12 and 23:31, yet KI-Auftrag shows 'M10 Okamoto ACC frei ab morgen 21:53' the whole time.
- M09 Studer is 'Bereit' at 10:37 but shows 'frei ab Mi 19:04'.
- M11 Waschanlage shows 'frei ab Mi 11:07' while idle.
Compare /tmp/rv-consistency/t1-ki-auftrag.png with /tmp/rv-consistency/t1-leitstand.png. A prospect sees the Leitstand say 'Bereit' and KI-Auftrag say busy until tomorrow night.
orders-ki.fix: Compute the first free window from fc.machines sorted by start: the first gap ≥ 2 h after now. Show 'jetzt frei · bis morgen 13:20' or 'frei ab 14:17'. If the last booking end is still wanted, label it 'verplant bis morgen 21:53' and add utilisation, e.g. '35 % belegt'.

orders-ki.title: Sticky result footer floats above the viewport bottom; content shows underneath it
orders-ki.evidence: /tmp/rv-art-desktop/ki-result-2.png and /tmp/rv-art-desktop/z-kisticky.png. The .ka-foot bar (Menge / Angebot netto / Auftragstermin / Auftrag einlasten) sticks about 28 px above the bottom, and cut-off lines ('Wendeschneidplatte 3,17 € · Fräser 2,50 € …') scroll visibly below it.
orders-ki.fix: Line 1485: make the bar flush with the viewport by setting bottom:-28px, which cancels the view's padding-block-end of 28px. Or remove the view's bottom padding for this view and add a 28px spacer after the result. Add a 24px top fade (linear-gradient from transparent to var(--bg)) above the bar so content slides under it cleanly.

material-tools.title: Materialfluss diagram labels render at about 6 px on phone, tablet portrait and 1024 landscape
material-tools.evidence: The SVG viewBox is 1200 wide (VW=1200, line 885) but is drawn into `.mt-fin{min-width:880px}` (line 479). Room/area labels (8.5px) render at 6.1px effective, station names (11px) at 7.9px, and 'M01' sub-ids and '1 unter Mindestbestand' at about 6.5px. Measured identically at 400, 768 and 1024 px wide (96 text nodes under 9.5px). The station boxes are unreadable without zoom (/tmp/rv-mobile/zoom-phone-material-flow.png, /tmp/rv-mobile/m-tab-material-0.png). This is the main material-flow visual the product owner wants to stand out.
material-tools.fix: For ≤1100px containers, set `.mt-fin{min-width:1200px}` so the diagram renders at 1:1 inside the existing swipe scroller; keep the 'zur Seite wischen' hint and add a right-edge fade (`mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 85%,transparent)`) as a scroll cue. Raise the minimum SVG text sizes: .mt-door/.mt-room-t/.mt-area/.mt-ext-t to 10px, .mt-el text to 12px, station sub-ids to 10px. For ≤560px, optionally replace the map with the existing 'Stärkste Verbindungen' list plus a 'Karte öffnen' fullscreen button.

material-tools.title: Wide tables on tablet hide the most important column (status) with no scroll cue
material-tools.evidence: Transportaufträge is 1083px inside a 730px wrapper at 768 and 1006/772 at 1024. Its last column 'Status' (Unterwegs/Offen pills) is cut mid-pill (/tmp/rv-mobile/land-material-transport.png, m-tab-material-1.png). Rohmaterial is 1102/730: 'Bestellt' and 'Lieferant' are hidden. Similar in Analyse 'Verlustmatrix' (Summe column cut at 768) and the Aufträge KPI strip on phone (1000/400, 'OFFENE AUF…' cut).
material-tools.fix: Use the existing phone card layout (.mt-trt/.mt-mtt block rows) up to `(max-width:1100px)` instead of only on phones, or move 'Status' to the 2nd column and hide 'Gewicht'/'Mittel' below 1100px. For any remaining horizontal scroller (.tbl-wrap, .or-kpis, .pe-mx-wrap), add a right fade `mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 calc(100% - 32px),transparent)` and a sticky first column.

material-tools.title: Material 'Entnahme heute' and Copilot 'Verbrauch heute' differ for bar stock
material-tools.evidence: MAT-TI10 at Mo 13:40: the Material table and drawer show 'Entnahme heute 6,0 m · 870 €' (UI ledger of store withdrawals). The Copilot shows 'Verbrauch heute: 15,0 m' (engine usedToday = 14.95). The Copilot also says 'Bedarf ca. 0,5 m – FA-24117: 70 × 0,050 m', which arithmetically is 3,5 m; the magazine deduction is not explained (rvcons/ti.js).
material-tools.fix: Show both values with clear labels in the table and drawer: 'Verbrauch 15,0 m (Maschine) · aus Lager entnommen 6,0 m'. In 60_ai, explain the deduction: '70 × 0,050 m = 3,5 m, davon 3,0 m im Stangenmagazin'.

material-tools.title: Identical action button on every table row (8× 'Nachbestellen'); same pattern in Anbindung (9× 'Verbessern')
material-tools.evidence: /tmp/rv-art-desktop/1440-material-2.png (Rohmaterial table) and /tmp/rv-art-desktop/1440-anbindung-1.png (50_connect.js). The one row that matters (AlMgSi1 under minimum, Okamoto L0) gets lost in a column of identical buttons.
material-tools.fix: Show the button only on actionable rows (below minimum, or open demand above stock; machine levels L0/L1), and reveal a ghost button on row hover for the rest. Keep the filled primary only on critical rows.

material-tools.title: Container drawer says the same thing three times and has an empty history
material-tools.evidence: /tmp/rv-art-desktop/d-container-BH-0002-0.png: pill 'Im Versand', tag 'Versand' and sentence 'Im Versand' stacked. The Verlauf shows only '06:00 Behälter angelegt an Messraum', although the container went AG 10 → AG 40.
material-tools.fix: Keep the pill plus one location line ('Versand · Fertigteillager'). Back-fill the Verlauf from the routing, marking pre-start steps as 'vor Simulationsstart', or hide the section when it has fewer than 2 entries.

material-tools.title: Werkzeuge list overflows the page horizontally on landscape tablets (1024, 1180, 1280 px)
material-tools.evidence: At 1024×768, view#view-werkzeuge has scrollWidth 919 vs clientWidth 810, so the whole page scrolls sideways. In 'Werkzeuge in den Maschinen', the plan column ('voraussichtlich nach Teil 26 · ca. 09:36', 'Kein Wechsel nötig') is cut at the right edge (/tmp/rv-mobile/land-werkzeuge-list.png). The same overflow appears at 912×1368 (919/698), 1180×820 (1083/966) and 1280×800 (1083/1066). Cause: the ≤1320px grid `--cols:40px minmax(200px,2fr) 150px 110px 146px minmax(180px,1.8fr)` needs about 914px, but beside the 214px sidebar only about 774px is available. The compact layout only applies at `@media (max-width:820px)`, which is based on the viewport, not the content width.
material-tools.fix: Base the layout on the content width. Add `container: tltb / inline-size` on the .tl-tb card and replace the 820px media query with `@container tltb (max-width: 940px)` (2-row layout: name+status, wear+rest, plan). Alternatively, apply the compact rules at `(max-width:1100px)` and add a 1101–1320px variant that drops the 'Stand/Schnittzeit' column. Add `min-width:0` and `overflow:hidden` to .tl-tr children so a grid can never push the page.

material-tools.title: Wechselplan on phone: M10 row text runs out of the card; machine names truncated
material-tools.evidence: In the Wechselplan at 400px, M10's 'kein Arbeitsgang · Werkzeuge bleiben bis zum nächs…' runs past the card edge and is clipped mid-word (.tl-rs, right edge 499px vs 400px viewport) (/tmp/rv-mobile/zoom-phone-tl-plan.png). Row labels are cut to 'INDEX G2…', 'Citizen …', 'Tiefbohr…', 'Liebherr…'.
material-tools.fix: On narrow widths use a short text ('kein AG · Werkzeuge bleiben montiert') and anchor it with `text-anchor:end` at the plot's right edge, or measure with getComputedTextLength() and truncate. Widen the label column on phone to 92px and show only the short name (e.g. 'INDEX', 'Citizen'), with the machine ID on the line above.

material-tools.title: Werkzeuge update() is about 5–10× costlier than other views because renderPlan rebuilds the whole SVG
material-tools.evidence:
200 calls of update() with WF.sim.advance(8) between them: Werkzeuge mean 8.6 ms, p95 23 ms, p99 110 ms, max 136 ms, 18 of 200 above 16 ms. Every other view: mean ≤ 2.3 ms, p95 ≤ 6 ms (rvcons/perf2.js).
CPU profile (rvcons/prof.js): renderPlan self time 967 ms of 1,599 ms total. Its signature includes Math.floor(now/30), so the whole Wechselplan SVG innerHTML is rebuilt every 30 sim-seconds, which is every tick at ≥ 120×.
material-tools.fix:
Split the static plan from the 'Jetzt' marker:
- Rebuild rows and hatches only when the machine/group signature or a 5-minute window bucket changes.
- Move the now line, now label and past shading via setAttribute(x/width) or a CSS transform on each tick.

material-tools.title: Werkzeuge page runs about 5 screens (4,258 px) at 1440
material-tools.evidence: /tmp/rv-art-desktop/1440-werkzeuge-0.png through -5.png: Wechselplan → a 19-row tool table (2 screens) → Werkzeugausgabe/Kosten → Bestand → Wechselhistorie. The first screen is strong, but the rest is hard to present.
material-tools.fix: Default the tool table to 'Dringlichste zuerst', showing the top 8 with an 'Alle 19 anzeigen' toggle. Put Bestand Werkzeugausgabe and Wechselhistorie into one tabbed card ('Bestand | Historie'). Target: two screens at 1440.

material-tools.title: Kopf 'Nächster Wechsel 10:47' ignoriert einen früheren voraussichtlichen Wechsel (10:43)
material-tools.evidence: Mo 10:30 Werkzeuge: Kopfkarte und KPI 'Nächster Wechsel · nach Teil 34 · Haas VF-4 (M06) · 10:47 / nächster 10:47 an M06'. Im Wechselplan steht M08 'WF m1,5 ca. 10:43' (voraussichtlich) – früher (cross-Lauf, Wechselplan-Liste).
material-tools.fix: Kopf als 'Nächster angekündigter Wechsel' beschriften oder voraussichtliche Wechsel einbeziehen und als 'voraussichtlich' markieren.

people-quality-connect.title: 'Lageplan · wer ist wo' is unreadable on phone/tablet and has no touch way to tell who is where
people-quality-connect.evidence: On 400px, station labels ('M01', 'Rohmaterial', 'Werkzeuge', 'Instandh.') render at 5–7.4px; it is the same at 768 (7.3px) and 1024 (7.8px). Persons are plain coloured dots without initials, and identities only appear on hover, which does not exist on touch (/tmp/rv-mobile/zoom-phone-pe-lageplan.png).
people-quality-connect.fix: On ≤900px, put the SVG in a horizontal scroller with `min-width:720px`, raise station text to 11px and area labels to 9.5px (≥10px effective), and draw the person's initials (font 9px bold) inside 16px circles. Make dots tappable (`WF.app.select('person', id)`) with a 32px invisible hit circle.

people-quality-connect.title: Shift timeline labels collide with pause markers and the now-line
people-quality-connect.evidence: 'Frühschicht' runs into the 09:00 pause hatch and the 08:51 now-line, and 'Spätschicht' touches the 16:00 hatch on 400px (/tmp/rv-mobile/zoom-phone-pe-shift.png). At 1024 the label 'Frühschicht 06:00–14:00' overlaps the first hatch (m-land-personal-0.png). KPI sublines are ellipsized ('1 unterwegs · 6 verfüg…', 'Arbeitszeit ÷ Anwese…').
people-quality-connect.fix: Put shift labels above the bar (small 11px caption row), or give them a solid background pill with `z-index` above the hatches. Hide the time range on narrow widths. Allow KPI .s lines to wrap to 2 lines on ≤1100px (`white-space:normal; -webkit-line-clamp:2`).

people-quality-connect.title: KPI 'Arbeiten gerade' sub-line wording reads as if available people are part of the working count
people-quality-connect.evidence: Mo 08:40: 'ARBEITEN GERADE 6 / 10 · davon 1 in Bereitschaft · 1 unterwegs · 3 verfügbar' (/tmp/rv-consistency/v0-personal.png; 47_people.js:884). The legend on the same screen says 'Arbeitet 6 · Unterwegs 1 · Verfügbar 3'. 'davon' only applies to the first item, but readers apply it to all three.
people-quality-connect.fix: Write 'davon 1 in Bereitschaft' and put the rest on a separate clause, e.g. 'außerdem 1 unterwegs · 3 verfügbar', or split into two lines.

people-quality-connect.title: Person drawer shows two different work-time totals side by side
people-quality-connect.evidence: /tmp/rv-art-desktop/d-person-P02-0.png, plus a probe on the current build (sim paused at Mo 08:40). The 'Arbeitszeit' tile and the 'Verlauf heute' legend 'Arbeitet' disagree: Ali Yilmaz 1 h 10 min vs 1 h 17 min; M. Gruber 35 min vs 40 min; L. Wagner 1 h 04 vs 57 min; J. Petrović 52 min vs 1 h. The comment at lines 25–26 claims the dark-green share matches the engine's workSec. This breaks UI_GUIDE rule 2 ('Eine Wahrheit') inside one panel.
people-quality-connect.fix: Compute the legend totals from the same source as the tile.
